description: hw/usb/hcd-xhci: More reentrancy guard fixes for the XHCI code
A flaw was found in QEMU's websocket I/O channel (QIOChannelWebsock in io/channel-websock.c).

A flaw was found in the USB CCID smartcard reader device emulation (hw/usb/dev-smartcard-reader.c) in QEMU. A guest can submit an interrupt IN transfer shorter than the 2-byte RDR_to_PC_NotifySlotChange message; usb_packet_copy() asserts

A flaw was found in the USB CCID (smartcard reader) device emulation (hw/usb/dev-smartcard-reader.c) in QEMU. For each PC_to_RDR_XfrBlock APDU received from the guest, ccid_on_apdu_from_guest() queues a pending answer without checking whether the slot is already busy.
hw/display/vga: fix OOB writes after external surface resize

An out-of-bounds read was found in the USB CCID smartcard reader device (hw/usb/dev-smartcard-reader.c) in QEMU. ccid_bulk_in_get() decremented the pending bulk-in slot count when a ring slot became active instead of when it was released, allowing a malicious guest to fill the bulk-in ring, partially read a slot, and then reuse the still-active slot with a shorter response.

A use-after-free flaw was found in the OHCI USB host controller emulation (hw/usb/hcd-ohci.c) in QEMU. When an isochronous transfer descriptor is directed at a non-isochronous endpoint, ohci_service_iso_td() can free a heap-allocated USBPacket while a pending asynchronous transfer still holds a reference to it; that reference is later dereferenced when the transfer completes.
IO::Compress::Brotli versions from 0.004001 before 0.023 for Perl bundle a brotli library with an out-of-bounds write in the decoder.
